verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents both halves of the story in one engine: vector indexes that rank embeddings by distance, and durable BM25 text indexes over string properties. The docs also say semantic and exact-term retrieval live together without syncing separate stores, but nothing shows the two signals combined in a single query or fused into one ranking. Missing for 10: documented single-request hybrid query combining vector and BM25, fusion ranking method (e.g., RRF or weighted scoring), hybrid query examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
